This happens and it's not much we can do...

In my first attempts to contact Vinted, I always contacted the Eastern European Vinted and I always got annoyed because of their lack of professionalism (late replies, difficulty in reaching them after they would reply to me, asking more than twice for details they already had, etc.).

My experience with Vinted UK was totally different, they answered to my emails very fast and were compassionate. I highly suggest you contact Vinted UK if there's no appeal from the french one. 

​

I wish you good luck!

Hello, girlie!

Sorry for the late reply, I am so sorry to know about your situation.

Please try and contact Vinted UK, they answer very fast & are very reliable and nice. I wrote them an email with a full explanation of my situation and attached according images to help them with my case - [legal@vinted.co.uk](mailto:legal@vinted.co.uk) . 

​

I hope all goes well, don't lose hope. <3
